rows.evidence: No legitimate free recording found: the text exists only in the in-copyright Yale Works of Jonathan Edwards edition, and searches of the LibriVox catalogue, Internet Archive and SermonAudio's feed returned no reading of it.
No legitimate free recording found: the sermon is published only in the in-copyright Yale WJE volume, and the LibriVox, Internet Archive and SermonAudio keyword searches returned nothing for it.

The Internet Archive page for LibriVox's 'Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' opens its player on track '11 - God Glorified in Man's Dependence', read by TriciaG, with streaming and MP3 download; the printed preface is track 10, 'Advertisement'.

The SermonAudio player page is titled 'Christian Charity: The Duty Of Charity To The Poor, Explained and Enforced' (Jonathan Edwards; broadcaster Puritan/Reformed Books and Sermons; 1:55:52) and has play and MP3 download; SermonAudio's feed says 'Narrated by Duane Linn', and the narrator notes he inserted a few comments of his own.
The Internet Archive LibriVox item 'Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' opens on track '03 - A Divine and Supernatural Light, pt 1', read by TriciaG, with streaming and download; part 2 is track 04.

The SermonAudio player page is titled 'Justification By Faith Alone (Complete)' (Jonathan Edwards; Puritan/Reformed Books and Sermons; 5:43:46) and has play and MP3 download; the feed calls it 'the complete book' and quotes Edwards's five-part outline of the discourse.

The Internet Archive LibriVox item 'Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' opens on track '36 - Pressing Into the Kingdom of God, pt 1', read by Anna Roberts, with streaming and download; parts 2 and 3 are tracks 37 and 38.

The Internet Archive page identifies itself as a 'LibriVox recording of Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' and opens on track '16 - The Excellency of Christ, pt 1', read by TriciaG, with a player and download link; parts 2 and 3 are tracks 17 and 18.
No legitimate free recording found: the text is available only in the in-copyright Yale WJE edition, and LibriVox, Internet Archive and SermonAudio searches returned no reading.

The SermonAudio player page is titled 'Charity and Its Fruits - 1' (Jonathan Edwards; broadcaster The Narrated Puritan, whose narrator is T M Sullivan; 1:31:15) and has play and download; it is part 1 of a two-part reading, and part 2 (1:29:27) is a separate file.
No legitimate free recording found: the sermon was first published in the in-copyright Yale WJE volume 22, and web, LibriVox and SermonAudio searches found no audio of it.

The Internet Archive LibriVox item 'Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' opens on track '01 - Sinners in the Hands of an Angry God, pt 1', read by dexter, with streaming and download; part 2 is track 02.

The SermonAudio player page is titled 'Distinguishing Marks of the Spirit's Work #1' (Jonathan Edwards; broadcaster Harbor Reformed Baptist Church; 1:13:03) and has play and download; its feed description quotes the aim of The Distinguishing Marks of a Work of the Spirit of God and says part #1 covers the 'Negative Signs', with parts #2 and #3 following.

The Internet Archive LibriVox item 'Select Sermons of Jonathan Edwards' opens on track '12 - True Saints, When Absent From The Body, Are Present With The Lord', read by Tyler Mitchell, with streaming and download; part 2 is track 13.

The SermonAudio player page is titled 'Farewell Sermon After Being Voted Out By His Congregation' (Jonathan Edwards; The Narrated Puritan; 1:04:18) and has play and download; its feed description says it was 'Preached at the First Church in Northampton, MA after being voted out as the Pastor July 1, 1750'.
